'''Myung Kyungjae''' ({{Korean|hangul=명경재}}; born May 4, 1968) is a biologist researching DNA repair pathways at the molecular level. He is a distinguished professor at the [[Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology]] (UNIST) and the director of the IBS Center for Genomic Integrity located on the UNIST campus. He is on the editorial board of various peer-reviewed journals and is a member of multiple scientific societies.

== Education ==
Majoring in zoology, Myung received his bachelor's from [[Seoul National University]] (SNU) graduating with honors in 1991. Continuing at SNU, he then majored in molecular biology and graduated with a M.S. in 1993 after studying under Professor Sang Dai Park. He completed a Ph.D. in molecular biology, cell biology and biochemistry from [[Brown University]] in 1999 under Professor Eric A. Hendrickson. His thesis was recognized with a Barry Jay Rosen Memorial Award.<ref name=":thesis">{{cite web |url= https://www.brown.edu/academics/biology/molecular-cell-biochemistry/graduate/mcb-graduate-student-handbook/student-handbook-barry-jay-rosen-award |title= Student Handbook - Barry Jay Rosen Award |author=<!--Not stated--> |website= Brown University |access-date= 17 July 2019 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20190125143541/https://www.brown.edu/academics/biology/molecular-cell-biochemistry/graduate/mcb-graduate-student-handbook/student-handbook-barry-jay-rosen-award |archive-date= 25 January 2019 }}</ref>

== Career==
[[File:Myung Kyungjae speaking at Seoul Forum 2023.jpg|thumb|Myung Kyungjae speaking at Seoul Forum 2023]]
Myung did his postdoctoral training at [[Ludwig Cancer Research|Ludwig Institute for Cancer Research]] in the University of California, San Diego from 1999 to 2002 under Professor [[Richard Kolodner]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1= Kolodner |first1= Richard D. |author-link1= Richard Kolodner |last2= Putnam |first2= Christopher D. |last3= Myung |first3= Kyungjae |date= 26 July 2002 |title= Maintenance of Genome Stability in Saccharomyces cerevisiae |journal= Science |volume= 297|issue= 5581 |pages= 552–557 |doi= 10.1126/science.1075277 |pmid= 12142524 |bibcode= 2002Sci...297..552K |s2cid= 6976371 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1= Myung |first1= Kyungjae |last2= Datta |first2= Abhijit |last3= Kolodner |first3= Richard D. |author-link3= Richard Kolodner |date= 9 February 2001 |title= Suppression of spontaneous chromosomal rearrangements by S phase checkpoint functions in Saccharomyces cerevisiae |journal= Cell |volume= 104 |issue= 3 |pages= 397–408 |doi= 10.1016/S0092-8674(01)00227-6 |pmid= 11239397 |doi-access= free }}</ref> He was awarded with a research fellowship from the Damon-Runyon-Winchell Cancer Research Foundation during the post-doc period.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.chosun.ac.kr/user/indexSub.do?framePath=unknownboard&siteId=bk21plusbioactive&dum=dum&boardId=191489&page=1&command=view&boardSeq=247833 |script-title=ko:제 57회 초청 강연회 개최 |last= 최 |first= 수영 |website= BK21생리활성제어기술 |publisher= [[Chosun University]] |access-date= 22 July 2019 |language= ko}}</ref> His first appointment was as an investigator and section head in the Genetics and Molecular Biology Branch of the [[National Human Genome Research Institute]] (NHGRI) under the [[National Institutes of Health]]. He was promoted to a senior investigator<ref name=":KSEA2013"/><ref>{{cite book |author=<!--Not stated--> |chapter= 재미한인과학기술자협회 연차보고서  |publisher= The Korean Federation of Science and Technology Societies |access-date= 23 July 2019 |language= ko |script-title=ko:해외한국과학기술자협회 2011 연차보고서 |page= 65 |chapter-url= https://www.kofst.or.kr/common/bbsdown.jsp?attNm=2011%20%ED%95%B4%EC%99%B8%EA%B3%BC%ED%98%91%20%EC%97%B0%EC%B0%A8%EB%B3%B4%EA%B3%A0%EC%84%9C(%EC%B5%9C%EC%A2%85).pdf }}</ref> and section head<ref>{{cite journal |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= October 2014 |title= KSEA Letters |url= https://seattle.ksea.org/pdf_files/KSEALetters_Vol_43_1_2014_StevenAndSeattleYGWonUKCPosterAwards.pdf |journal= Journal of the Korean-American Scientists and Engineers Association |volume= 45|page= 10 |access-date= 23 July 2019 |isbn= 978-0-9911337-5-8 }}</ref> in 2009, a position he held until 2014.

In addition to his position at the National Human Genome Research Institute, he concurrently held a position at [[POSTECH]] in the Division of Molecular and Life Science as an adjunct professor from 2011 until 2014. From 2013, he worked as an adjunct professor at [[KAIST]] in the Department of Biological Sciences and at the [[Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology]] (UNIST) in the School of Nano-Bioscience and Chemical Engineering. The following year he fully relocated to [[Ulsan]] where he became a distinguished professor in the School of Life Sciences at UNIST while also becoming the founding director of the IBS Center for Genomic Integrity, a collaboration with the [[Institute for Basic Science]].

Myung has been a guest associate editor for the journal ''[[PLoS Genetics]]'',<ref>{{cite journal |last1= Iraqui |first1= Ismail |last2= Kienda |first2= Guy |last3= Soeur |first3= Jérémie |last4= Faye |first4= Gérard |last5= Baldacci |first5= Giuseppe |last6= Kolodner |first6= Richard D. |last7= Huang |first7= Meng-Er |date= 19 June 2009 |title= Peroxiredoxin Tsa1 Is the Key Peroxidase Suppressing Genome Instability and Protecting against Cell Death in Saccharomyces cerevisiae |journal= [[PLOS Genetics]] |volume= 5 |issue= 6 |article-number= e1000524|doi= 10.1371/journal.pgen.1000524 |pmid= 19543365 |editor= Myung Kyungjae|pmc= 2688748 |doi-access= free }}</ref> a guest editor for ''[[Mutation Research (journal)|Mutation Research]]'',<ref>{{cite journal |last1= Myung |first1= Kyungjae |date= May 2018 |title= Eukaryotic 4Rs: DNA replication, repair, recombination, and damage response |journal= Mutation Research |volume= 809 |pages= 56–57 |doi= 10.1016/j.mrfmmm.2018.04.002 |pmid= 29728263 |doi-access=  |bibcode= 2018MRFMM.809...56M }}</ref> and been on the Editorial Board for ''Genome Instability and Disease'', ''[[Genomics (journal)|Genomics]]'',<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.jgenomics.com/editorial |title= Editorial Board |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= 2019 |website= [[Genomics (journal)|Genomics]] |access-date= 23 July 2019 }}</ref> ''Genome Integrity'',<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.genome-integrity.org/editorialboard.asp |title= Editorial Board |author=<!--Not stated--> |website= Genome Integrity |access-date= 23 July 2019 }}</ref> and ''[[Molecular and Cellular Biology]]''. He is also a member of the [[American Association for Cancer Research]], [[Genetics Society of America]], Korean-American Scientists and Engineers Association, [[Environmental Mutagenesis and Genomics Society]], [[Korean Society for Biochemistry and Molecular Biology]], and Korean Society for Integrative Biology.
